definition.description: Encodes or decodes HTML entities. Converts special characters to/from HTML entities like &lt;, &gt;, &amp;, etc.

inputFields.helpText: The text to encode or decode.
Encode converts to entities, Decode converts from entities.
Also encode single and double quotes.
